name: kotlet
description: Connects Codex to your Kotlet kitchen: recipes, ingredients, pantry, shopping list, and meal plans over the hosted Kotlet MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Import recipes into Kotlet and plan meals from your own kitchen data.
interface.longDescription: Kotlet keeps your recipes, pantry, meal plans, and shopping list in one place. This plugin connects Codex to the hosted Kotlet MCP server over OAuth and adds workflows for importing recipes and safely updating an existing recipe after reading its complete state.
defaultPrompt: Attach this playable video to an existing Kotlet recipe.
Check whether this recipe is already in my Kotlet kitchen.
What is on my Kotlet shopping list?
